**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**5. US vs Global?**
US outperforms: SPY (1W: +3.06% | 1M: -0.14%) RECOVERY. Europe/Japan showing strength vs US (Europe vs US above trend); China mixed but short-term bounce: FXI (1W: +2.85% | 1M: -7.90%) RECOVERY, EEM (1W: +0.57% | 1M: -2.86%) RECOVERY.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Metals mixed: CPER (1W: +1.37% | 1M: -4.01%) RECOVERY, GLD (1W: +2.27% | 1M: -6.31%) RECOVERY, SLV (1W: +5.31% | 1M: -15.25%) RECOVERY — reflation signals present but MTD profit-taking.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy showing weakness: XLE (1W: -1.32% | 1M: -8.85%) BELOW TREND; oil ETFs BNO (1W: -0.92% | 1M: -25.95%) BELOW TREND and UNG (1W: -1.35% | 1M: +0.00%) NEUTRAL.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: VXX ↓ and SPY/TLT ↑ plus XLF ABOVE TREND are independent confirmations of the RISK-ON label. DIVERGENCE: Multiple 1W vs 1M mismatches across core ETFs (XLK RECOVERY, TLT CORRECTION, IWM CORRECTION) constitute a MAJOR Divergence — temper conviction and watch momentum.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor cyclical exposure and growth-tilt trades that participate in risk: XLF (1W: +4.80% | 1M: +10.75%) ABOVE TREND, XBI (1W: +3.49% | 1M: +23.98%) ABOVE TREND, XLI (1W: +2.41% | 1M: +6.88%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to energy/real-estate ETFs showing weakness (XLE (1W: -1.32% | 1M: -8.85%) BELOW TREND, XLRE (1W: -2.92% | 1M: +2.32%) CORRECTION). Bonds neutral given TLT CORRECTION.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Financials XLF (1W: +4.80% | 1M: +10.75%) ABOVE TREND; Industrials XLI (1W: +2.41% | 1M: +6.88%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Energy XLE (1W: -1.32% | 1M: -8.85%) BELOW TREND; Utilities XLU (1W: -1.95% | 1M: +4.30%) CORRECTION.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Silver SLV (1W: +5.31% | 1M: -15.25%) RECOVERY if momentum continues. BEARISH: Oil BNO (1W: -0.92% | 1M: -25.95%) BELOW TREND and broad energy complex likely to remain weak.

**13. Key Levels?**
Watch VXX ~20 (complacency marker); HYG/LQD credit spread ~0.73 (credit stress); SPY/TLT ~8.79 (stocks vs bonds pivot); XLK/XLF ratio Level 3.27 (tech vs financials tilt).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive with VXX (1W: -8.79% | 1M: -11.60%) BELOW TREND and SPY (1W: +3.06% | 1M: -0.14%) RECOVERY confirming risk appetite. Financials and Industrials (XLF (1W: +4.80% | 1M: +10.75%) ABOVE TREND, XLI (1W: +2.41% | 1M: +6.88%) ABOVE TREND) showing relative strength while tech is a RECOVERY. Key risk: MAJOR divergence across 1W vs 1M in core ETFs (XLK, TLT, IWM) — monitor for momentum fade.
